sections.body:

sections.body: The card detail text only appears in the full (non-interactive) snapshot. The -i flag might filter out the detail paragraph as non-interactive.
sections.label: Actual Behavior

sections.body: The -i flag filters to interactive elements only (buttons, links, inputs, etc.), which excludes the expanded detail paragraph since it's a static text element.
sections.label: Root Cause Analysis

sections.body:
- Document that -i mode excludes expanded/hovered content that isn't directly interactive
- Consider including elements that became visible due to interaction in the -i output

issues.title: Priority list drag reorder places item above target instead of below

sections.body:
1. Drag e1254 (High Priority, original position 1) onto e1257 (Backlog, position 4)
2. Result order: Medium → Low → High → Backlog
3. High Priority ends up at position 3, not position 4 (bottom)
sections.label: Reproduction

sections.body: Dragging an item onto the last item should place it after that item (at the bottom).
sections.label: Expected Behavior

sections.body: High Priority was placed above Backlog (position 3 of 4), not below it (position 4 of 4). This is insertion-before-target behavior rather than insertion-after-target.
sections.label: Actual Behavior

sections.body: The drag implementation uses insertion-before-target semantics (insertBefore) rather than checking if the target is the last element to use appendChild. This is standard HTML5 drag behavior but may not match user expectations for 'drag to bottom'.
sections.label: Root Cause Analysis

sections.body: browser4-core/browser4-browser/ — PulsarWebDriver drag implementation
sections.label: Code Pointer

sections.body:
- Document the drag insertion semantics (before vs after target) in the command help
- Consider adding a --position flag (before|after|replace) for drag operations
- The current behavior is consistent with HTML5 drag-and-drop spec but the help should clarify this
sections.label: AI Suggested Improvement
